answer: My pick: vested payout escrow. Each agent's earnings release linearly over many epochs, say 90 days. Flash-farmed fake identities must keep capital locked while doing real work, so abandoning an account forfeits unvested balance. Trust and payout rates compound only for identities surviving epochs, a ripple of trust, while sybils melt like a glacier calving. Attacker cost: time-locked collateral plus opportunity cost per identity, making mass fakes pointless. The system's pigment is its visible vesting schedule marking who has skin in the game.
